description: Twitter Demos Taxonomy organized by primary use case

categories.name: Browser Use
categories.description: Web automation, auto form filling, web scraping, browser navigation, and web game interaction

categories.name: Computer Use
categories.description: Desktop and mobile UI automation, OS clicking, app scheduling, shortcuts, and GUI agent operations

categories.name: Workflow Guardrails
categories.description: Workflow gating, permission blocking, database protection, security, and code compliance guardrails

categories.name: Financial
categories.description: High-frequency quantitative trading, on-chain crypto arbitrage, real-time risk control, and market signal execution

categories.name: Pipeline Routing
categories.description: Fast/slow model routing, tool pre-calling, multi-agent coordination, and sub-agent dispatch

categories.name: Feed Cleanup
categories.description: Social feed curation, ad blocking, spam filtering, low-quality post hiding, and sensitive content masking

categories.name: Categorization
categories.description: Email classification and triage, bookmark archiving, tweet intent detection, and invoice receipt categorization

categories.name: Ranking & Evaluation
categories.description: Content quality scoring, viral tweet prediction, code PR review evaluation, and candidate domain assessment

categories.name: Search
categories.description: Natural language database query, semantic file search, text retrieval, and contextual reranking

categories.name: Input Assistance
categories.description: Voice control and turn detection, keyboard typing suggestions, inline autocomplete, edit prediction, and candidate recommendations

categories.name: Native Play
categories.description: AI-native game mechanics, generative gameplay, and novel interactive game genres powered by AI

categories.name: Realtime Gameplay
categories.description: Real-time game control, arcade games like Pacman, Super Mario, Tetris, FPS, and dynamic reflex action

categories.name: Turn Strategy
categories.description: Turn-based strategy, chess, card battles (CCG), board games, and strategic decision making

categories.name: Virtual Behaviors
categories.description: Autonomous NPC behaviors, multi-agent social simulations, virtual worlds, and environment swarm control

categories.name: Robotic Arms
categories.description: Robotic arm manipulation, grasping, zero-shot tool use, workpiece sorting, and physical robotics

categories.name: Autonomous Transit
categories.description: Drone flight control, autonomous driving, path planning, steering, and vehicle obstacle avoidance

categories.name: Multimodal Generation
categories.description: Pixel-level drawing, image generation, music and sheet music composition, and dynamic emotion color palette rendering

categories.name: Text Generation
categories.description: Text generation, creative writing, copy generation, and natural language synthesis

categories.name: Hacks
categories.description: Experimental hacks, hooking decoders to decision models, reverse captchas, jailbreaks, and unconventional prompt engineering
